issuerName: BrasilAgro – Brazilian Agricultural Real Estate Company

segments.name: Real estate
segments.description: Sells the Company's agricultural farms and rural properties, generating gains on sale of farms for the group.
segments.evidence: The real estate segment presents the results of operations carried out in the Company's subsidiaries.

segments.name: Grains
segments.description: Produces and sells soybean, corn and beans to crop customers in Brazil, Paraguay and Bolivia.
segments.evidence: The main activity of the grains segment is the production and sale of soybean, corn and beans.

segments.name: Sugarcane
segments.description: Produces and sells the raw sugarcane product to sugar and ethanol mills and other buyers.
segments.evidence: The sugarcane segment includes the sale of the raw product.

segments.name: Cattle
segments.description: Runs a cattle breeding, rearing and fattening operation and sells beef calves after weaning.
segments.evidence: The cattle raising segment consists of the production and sale of beef calves post-weaning, characterized as a cattle breeding, rearing, and fattening operation.

segments.name: Cotton
segments.description: Produces and sells cotton lint and cotton seed to buyers of the fibre and seed.
segments.evidence: The cotton segment is engaged primarily in the production and sale of cotton lint and seed.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Holds insignificant services and crops outside the main farming segments, including minor cereals.
segments.evidence: The Company has six segments, namely: (i) real estate, (ii) grains, (iii) sugarcane, (iv) cattle, (v) cotton and (vi) other, basically represented by insignificant services and crops.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the Company for agricultural commodities and farms it produces and sells, with much of the crop sold to a few large buyers.
revenueModel.evidence: We currently sell a substantial portion of our total crop production to a small number of customers who have considerable bargaining power.
